comment: Payment operations generated into payment_kashier_cf/kashier_api.py. host: dashboard (test-api / api) or fep (test-fep / fep). auth: secret = raw Secret Key in Authorization; secret+apikey = also the Payment API Key in api-key; hash = Kashier-Hash header (HMAC-SHA256 with the Payment API Key); none = no credential.

excluded.createToken: Takes the raw card number: card data would pass through the merchant's server (PCI DSS scope). Cards are saved on Kashier's hosted page instead.
excluded.getPaymentSessionById: Unauthenticated read. Payment states are only taken from reads made with the Secret Key.
excluded.*: Every other operation is not a payment operation (payouts and transfers, merchant settings, API keys, webhook management, payment links, reports, customers, discounts).
